comment: Priority order: (1) @acornsoftai Radar subscription, (2) Grok Build, (3) Imagine, (4) Voice, (5) Elon orgs (xAI/SpaceXAI, SpaceX, Tesla, Grok model). Subscriptions run first; queries follow array order.

subscriptions.label: Acornsoft Radar
subscriptions.note: Priority 1 — every @acornsoftai post (Climb Notes, Advanced Development, studio) lands on Canopy.

queries.query: ("Grok Build" OR GrokBuild) (from:elonmusk OR from:xai OR from:XFreeze OR from:SpaceXAI) (changelog OR release OR update OR CLI OR workflow OR plugin OR agent OR v0. OR publish)
(from:elonmusk OR from:xai OR from:SpaceXAI) ("Grok Imagine" OR Imagine) (image OR video OR template OR edit OR restyle OR creative OR emoji OR merch OR render)
(from:elonmusk OR from:xai OR from:SpaceXAI) ("Grok Voice" OR "Think Fast" OR Voice) (agent OR speech OR audio OR dictation OR builder OR telephony OR Tau)
(from:elonmusk OR from:xai OR from:SpaceXAI) (Grok OR xAI OR SpaceXAI OR Colossus OR model)
(from:SpaceX OR from:elonmusk) (Starship OR Falcon OR Starlink OR launch OR recover OR Raptor OR Dragon)
(from:Tesla OR from:elonmusk OR from:Tesla_AI) (Optimus OR Tesla OR Supercharger OR FSD OR robotaxi OR Cybertruck OR energy)
